card.name: First digit of a dose number
card.fires_on: The first digit of a multi-digit number that is split into pieces, usually a dose or amount right before mg, mcg, mL or units. It is often a 1, 2, 3, 4 or 5 starting a number.

modes.label: Dose amount digit
modes.description: Leading digit of a dose figure in a dosing table or instruction.
modes.example: The recommended dosage to initiate treatment with Morphine Sulfate Oral Solution 20 mg/mL in opioid tolerant adults is <<1>>0 mg to 20 mg every
